fact: The Pôle Digital of the Ministry of Agriculture operates a drought observatory geoportal using CHIRPS, MODIS and SMAP satellite sources with monthly, quarterly and annual reporting by province, and crop maps from satellite imagery with 2025 use cases at Sidi Kacem and R'mel.
title: LOA Pôle Digital / FAO : Géoservices agricoles par satellite et IA
publisher: Pôle Digital de l'Agriculture, de la Forêt et Observatoire de la Sécheresse
